name: Percival
subtitle: Faithful Knight
description: Resilient brawler that excels in resisting enemy debuffs and taunt heroes aligned with Chaos.
lore: Known as one of Arthur’s most skilled and virtuous knights, Percival has shifted his methods since the Shattering. He rides Avalon and its surroundings as a knight errant and rogue agent, fighting and questing for the good of his king and Destiny by whatever means he sees fit—without waiting for the approval, or even knowledge, of either.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when this hero resists a debuff.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Vow of Rectification
Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Inquisitive Smite
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 25% chance to remove a random buff. Will Ignore 20% of the target’s defence when attacking Chaos enemies.

skills.name: Resist Temptation
skills.description: Increase this hero’s Resistance by 10% for each buff they are under.
skills.awakening_bonus: This ability is still under review - please check back later.

skills.name: Vow of Rectification
skills.description: Place [mechanic:res-up-ii] and [mechanic:radiance-ii] on this hero for 2 turns. Has a 50% to place [mechanic:stun] for 1 turn on all enemies.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the enemy is aligned with Chaos, increase the chance to place [Stun] by 25% and ignore 25% of their RES.

skills.name: Righteous Retribution
skills.description: Remove all [Debuffs] and [Disables] from this hero, then attack 1 enemy. If no debuffs are removed, place [mechanic:retaliate] and [mechanic:ward] on this hero for 2 turns before attacking.

imprint_passive: Increase this hero’s Resistance by 5% for each buff they are under.
